text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's cabinet urges Israel to honour peace process.
- Expanding Bahrain's non-oil industrial sector and reducing reliance on oil is a priority for the oil and industry ministry, minister says.
- Aluminium Bahrain installs two fume treatment plants at a cost of 10 million dinars.
- Arab Bank to spend three million dinars to build headquarters in Manama.
- Bahrain is taking steps to ensure government operations are not seriously affected by the computer glitch which will hit the world in the year 2000.
- Construction work is to start on Bahrain's first 218,000 dinar footbridge in September.
- Bahrain Cinema Company announces a 54 percent increase in profit to 315,260 dinars in the first six months of 1997.
- Industrial sector contribution to Bahrain's gross domestic product increased 18 percent last year, oil minister says.
- Bahrain's Emir congratulates Iran's new president.
- Bahrain spent $11.8 million on advertisement in the first six months of 1997, up 32 percent from the same period a year earlier.
